# `security-alternative-removed`

Security alternative removed

| | |
|---|---|
| **Kind** | `wire` |
| **Default severity** | `error` |
| **Rule IDs** | `security-alternative-removed` |
| **Status** | Implemented (M3) |
| **Group** | Security ([RULES.md section 3](../../RULES.md)) |

## What it detects

An alternative was removed from the `security` list.

## Why this default

Clients using that way of authenticating get 401/403 responses.

## Example

From test case [`security-alternative-removed`](../../test/cases/security-alternative-removed/): An alternative clients may use was removed.

`openapi.yaml`, base → revision:

```diff
  …
        operationId: listPets
        security:
-       - apiKey: []
        - oauth:
          - read
```

Findings:

- `security-alternative-removed` · error · GET /pets

## Test cases

The example above is the only test case for this rule.


## Policy options

Every rule takes `severity` (`error`, `warn`, `info` or `off`), `fix` and `explanation` in the policy file. The policy file arrives in M6; see [POLICY.md](../../POLICY.md).

```yaml
rules:
  security-alternative-removed: error
```

## How to fix

Keep the alternative until clients have moved to another one.
